text:
The preview page carries an instruction asking search engines not to index it, follow its links, archive it or show a snippet of it. No publication date and no public address are recorded for a previewed draft, and the preview is marked as not public. Producing the preview involves no network call and no live publishing.

TextOS keeps three states apart: whether the draft passed its fact-check, whether it was previewed, and whether it was published. A preview cannot be mistaken for a go-live, and a go-live cannot be read into a passing check. Previewing a draft leaves its checked status in place, so the same draft can be previewed again, which a test now covers.
